name: YIELD
description: YIELD returns the annual yield to maturity for a bond based on its price, coupon, redemption value, and payment frequency.
tldr: Calculates the yield to maturity of a security that pays periodic interest.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.explanation: A 10-year bond with a 5% coupon, priced at $92.64, has a yield to maturity of about 6%.

howItWorks: YIELD solves for the discount rate that makes the present value of all future coupon payments plus the redemption value equal to the current price.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: For bonds with irregular coupon periods, use ODDFYIELD or ODDLYIELD.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: YIELD works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between YIELD and YIELDMAT?
faq.answer: YIELD is for periodic coupon bonds. YIELDMAT is for securities that pay interest at maturity.

faq.question: What does yield to maturity measure?
faq.answer: It is the total annual return if the bond is held to maturity and all payments are made as scheduled.
